description: Navigate is a Craft CMS plugin for building menus and navigations. Navigations are containers (title, handle, levels, allowed sources); nodes are the items inside them (URL, entry/asset element, or heading), and can be nested. Read a navigation in Twig with craft.navigate.raw('handle'); create navigations and nodes with the console commands or through the NavigateService and NodesService.
rules: To read a navigation for output use the Twig variable craft.navigate.raw('navHandle') or craft.navigate.raw('navHandle', siteId). It returns an ordered array of nodes; each node exposes name, url, classes, blank, type, children, active() and current().

In Craft 6 the PHP API lives on Navigate::getInstance()->navigate (NavigateService, navigations as NavigationRecord Eloquent models) and Navigate::getInstance()->nodes (NodesService, nodes as NodeRecord Eloquent models).

Create a navigation with Navigate::getInstance()->navigate->saveNavigation(new NavigationRecord([...])) with title, handle, levels, allowedSources ('*' or a JSON array of node types), enabledSiteGroups ('*' or a JSON array of site group ids) and adminOnly. It returns nothing and writes through project config; re-fetch it with getNavigationByHandle('handle', false) to get its id.

Add an item with Navigate::getInstance()->nodes->save(new NodeRecord([...])) with name, navId, siteId and type. save() assigns the order and sets the record's id. The services don't validate; the console commands do.

A node's type is 'url', 'element' or 'heading'. For a 'url' node set url. For an 'element' node set elementType ('entry' or 'asset') and elementId; the URL resolves from the element per site. Category nodes are not supported in Craft 6.
Nest a node by setting parent to the parent node's id. The navigation's levels must be greater than 1 for children to render. Deleting a node deletes its descendants.
Nodes are stored per site (siteId). Create nodes once per site for multi-site menus.

Console commands (all support --json): php artisan navigate:navigations:list, php artisan navigate:navigations:create "Main menu" mainMenu --levels=2, php artisan navigate:nodes:list mainMenu, php artisan navigate:nodes:add mainMenu "Home" --type=url --url=/. The Craft 5 names (php craft navigate/nodes/add) work as aliases.

For navigate:nodes:add, --type is one of url, entry, asset, heading. url requires --url; entry/asset require --element-id. Optional: --parent=<nodeId>, --site=<handle|id> (defaults to the primary site), --blank, --classes.
Pages that render a navigation get the cache tags 'navigate' and 'navigate:{handle}:{siteId}', which are invalidated when nodes or linked elements change.
